refresh_note: Event holds maintained. Stale/date-missing events require web access to Visit Busan or official Busan city event sources for refresh. No network fetch performed for individual events as event pages require session-based browser access (SSR). Recommend periodic manual refresh.
new_stale_threshold: Reference date 2026-08-08. Events with end_date < 2026-07-01 are presumed past.

stale_reclassification.note: Events with end_date < 2026-07-01 are eligible for HOLD_PAST_EVENT reclassification.
